office_does: The District Court judge hears misdemeanors, DUIs, traffic infractions, small claims and protection orders for all of Stevens County.
race_blurb: Judge Gina Tveit, on the bench since 2009, faces Colville attorney C. Olivia Irwin, who has practiced for 12 years and submitted no voters' guide statement.

candidates.summary: Colville attorney of 12 years seeking her first judicial office; she submitted no voters' guide statement.
highlights: Says she has practiced law for 12 years [S2]
Wants to expand access to justice and advocate for the planned justice center [S2]
Submitted no statement to the voters' guide [S1]

experience.basis: First-time judicial candidate challenging a 17-year incumbent.

candidates.summary: Stevens County District Court judge since 2009 and a former prosecutor, running on experience.
highlights: Judge since 2009; re-elected in 2014, 2018 and unopposed in 2022 [S1][S3][S4][S5]
Helped develop the county's veterans court, therapeutic drug court, 24/7 alcohol monitoring and probation services [S1]
Says she holds offenders accountable while supporting rehabilitation [S1]

experience.basis: Seventeen-year incumbent re-elected three times who runs on experience.

safety.basis: Pairs holding offenders accountable with therapeutic and veterans courts and probation services built for rehabilitation.
